description: List the underlying spending transactions for a window. Optionally drill down into a category bucket (bucketKind='category', bucketId=CategoryType or 'UNCATEGORIZED') or a merchant bucket (bucketKind='merchant', bucketType=..., bucketId=user UUID for type='user'). Paginated via take/skip. Amounts are in currency units (26.5 means 26.50), like `get_transactions`.

from.description: ISO 8601 UTC start of an absolute window

period.description: Rolling time window. Mutually exclusive with from/to.

to.description: ISO 8601 UTC end of an absolute window

name: get_spending_transactions
